answer: The manifest lists a name once it holds Appointed rat catcher cellar licence, and a licence catchers carry after trap inspections is the entry the clerk looks for. Each attempt carries 95 separate visits, each one billed £22 at the door, and the charge lands before any reward is even counted. The toll does the work that no ban list ever could. Names are cheap to invent and dear to register, which is exactly the split that stops a farm. The crystal is on the docket. plume is written on the receipt. Every bridge is counted once.
